content: Werewolf novel  Based on Ferdinand III and his sword  Lobera  ,  This is a generational novel. Basically the main character is of the royal bloodline based in this day and age in America.  However  he is the last descendant and he is approached by a secret Franciscan sect, this sect wants him to take possession of the sword to kill Werewolves,  Not all werewolves are bad he will come to find out just like not all the members of the  franscican  sect are good.  Before long he finds out that the source of the wolves isn’t god and the devil or paranormal at all, but instead its genetic, a gift given to a few early bloodlines to help protect man as he evolved, but the gift has been twisted by some and coveted by others, and still some would see it eradicated in the name of  there  god.
